name: Orb · Phosphor
description: An ASCII glyph matrix in CRT green, wrapped on the ball: a resolution-relative grid of woven dash characters whose lit-row count quantizes a streaming fbm field — exactly how ASCII art shades — with blocky dropouts eaten out of the matrix on a coarser super-grid, a stereographic wrap that rolls the weave around the sphere, and a phosphor ramp from deep green to hot glow (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-23 (MIT).
